fix.notes: Single-line change adding `--format compact` to the eslint invocation. The compact format is a built-in eslint formatter so no new dependencies are introduced. The `--fix` flag path is unaffected as the format flag is placed before it in the command list.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

When `do_jslint()` in `dev.py` ran eslint and encountered issues, eslint's default `stylish` formatter emitted multi-line blocks per problem — typically 4-6 lines each — producing ~1000 lines of output for a file with many violations.

## What changed

Added `--format`, `compact` to the eslint command in `do_jslint()` (`dev.py` line 273). The `compact` formatter emits one line per problem in the form `file:line:col: message [rule]`, preserving all issue information while keeping output proportional to the number of problems found.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python -m pytest dev_test.py::test_find_files -p no:timeout` — 1 passed (only test relevant to `dev.py`; full suite conftest.py hits the database during initialization which timed out in this environment even after MariaDB was started)

Fixes #12584
fix.pr_title: Use compact format for eslint output to reduce verbosity (#12584)

tests.command: uv run --frozen python -m pytest dev_test.py::test_find_files -p no:timeout
tests.detail: 1 passed in 0.15s; full suite env-blocked by database init in conftest.py timing out at 120s even after MariaDB was started — the specific dev_test was the only relevant test and it passed

fix.notes: eslint v9 removed the `compact` formatter from core; the PR's `--format compact` flag caused exit code 2 (fatal error). Fix installs `eslint-formatter-compact@^9.0.1` as a devDependency, restoring the exact behavior the PR intended. `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` and `uv run --frozen python dev.py jslint` both pass.

tests.detail: unit tests require DB; lint and jslint both passed

evidence.detail: do_jslint() calls eslint with no format or verbosity flags, producing default stylish output (~many lines per violation across all .js/.jsx files)
eslint supports --quiet (errors only), -f compact (one line per issue), and --max-warnings <n> — none currently passed

triage.fix_sketch: In dev.py do_jslint() (line ~273), append '--format', 'compact' to cmd before the file list. compact format emits one line per problem ('file:line:col: message [rule]') instead of multi-line stylish blocks, dramatically reducing output while preserving all issue info. Alternatively add '--max-warnings', '0' to hard-fail on warnings without changing output format.
